name: boar_rider
description: a Boar Rider, a stocky dwarf with a long braided orange beard in a steel helmet with gold bands, steel shoulder plates and grey mail over a brown leather coat, a round wooden shield with a gold rim and a steel boss on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped wooden spear held upright in his LEFT hand, riding a big brown bristly war boar with a dark bristle mane, small eyes, curved white tusks, a pink snout, a leather harness with gold studs and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the dwarf's left hand on the screen-right side and the round shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
